$comment: Source of truth for the bar/dispensary UniFi build - REBUILT 2026-09-09 from scratch to a simpler model. Passphrases are NEVER stored here - each WLAN names an environment variable the provisioning script reads at runtime. All four WLANs share one passphrase today (WIFI_FIELDS_PSK); the value lives out-of-band.
design_note: Two secure tenant networks (one per business), one wired open-to-internet network, one shared wifi where devices can talk to each other, one staff wifi that is client-isolated and internet-only. VLAN ID == third octet of the subnet so nothing needs a lookup table. Fresh IDs (100+) were chosen so the new networks could be built alongside the old ones and the old ones torn down last.

networks.name: MGMT
networks.note: Default LAN. Controller, switches, APs, PDU, 5G backup. Untouched by the rebuild.

networks.name: BAR-SECURE
networks.note: The bar's one private network - POS, back office, everything. Replaces BAR-POS/BAR-BACK/BAR-IOT.

networks.name: DISP-SECURE
networks.note: The dispensary's one private network - POS, seed-to-sale, back office. Replaces DISP-POS/DISP-BACK.

networks.name: OPEN-NET
networks.note: Internet-only, wired only, no DHCP server - Jason assigns static addresses by hand (he has a static plan). Fully isolated from every internal network. 'corporate' purpose with explicit block policies rather than the 'guest' purpose, so the isolation is written down in the firewall and not implied by a network type.

networks.name: SHARED-SECURE
networks.note: Shared by both tenants. Devices on it CAN talk to each other - that is its purpose. Wifi only; every switch port is already spoken for.

networks.name: STAFF
networks.note: Staff personal devices. Client-isolated - devices cannot see each other - and internet-only. Short lease; phones come and go. Distinct from SHARED-SECURE, which is the opposite (devices talk).

wlans.name: BAR-SECURE-WIFI
wlans.note: Wireless leg of the bar's private network. Hidden - it is a private business network. Scope to a 'bar' AP group once one exists; broadcasting on all 5 APs until then.

wlans.name: DISP-SECURE-WIFI
wlans.note: Wireless leg of the dispensary's private network. Un-hidden 2026-09-09 at Jason's request so it can be joined from the SSID list on site - BAR-SECURE-WIFI is still hidden, so the two tenants deliberately differ here. Scope to a 'dispensary' AP group once one exists.

wlans.name: SHARED-SECURE-WIFI
wlans.note: Visible. Devices on it talk to each other.

wlans.name: STAFF-WIFI
wlans.note: Visible. Client isolation ON at the SSID - this is the setting that makes 'isolated per device' real. Internet only.

firewall_policies.why: The one rule that never changes
A laptop on the bar's secure ports can reach the controller - Jason's 'so I can access to manage it'
Shared devices talk to each other, not into either tenant's private network

wan.failover: WAN3 UniFi 5G backup, configured, 10 GB monthly cap
wan.note: Reverted to DHCP 2026-09-09 after two static attempts failed - see HANDOFF.md. The leased address is private, which means the modem is in router/NAT mode; a public static on the UDM's WAN needs Frontier to put it in bridge/IP-passthrough first, or to route the block to the modem's LAN side. Ask Frontier before retrying. There is no static-then-DHCP auto-fallback on a single WAN - the fallback is manual, at Settings > Internet > Internet 1 > IPv4 > DHCP.

static_to_retry.note: Jason's second set. Looks like a real routed assignment. Never cleanly applied - the netmask picker displayed 24 while its state stayed 30. Type the netmask, don't pick it.

constraints.note: The U7 Pro XG APs cap at 4 SSIDs per radio band. The four WLANs above are exactly at that limit - adding a fifth requires removing one, or scoping SSIDs to per-tenant AP groups so no single AP carries more than four. This is what forced the Fields Guest teardown before STAFF-WIFI could be created.

removed_2026_09_09.note: The previous design was torn down after the new one was verified live. Recorded so nobody goes looking for these in the controller.
networks: STAFF (31, renamed STAFF-OLD before deletion to disambiguate from the new STAFF/170)

manual_steps: DONE 2026-09-09: six zones built, block-by-default between all of them, Allow Bar-Secure->Mgmt and Allow Disp-Secure->Mgmt added
DONE 2026-09-09: Client Device Isolation ON for STAFF-WIFI, OFF for SHARED-SECURE-WIFI - both verified after save
DONE 2026-09-09: OPEN-NET DHCP set to None
OPEN: pin static IPs / DHCP reservations for both switches on MGMT - they hold dynamic leases today
OPEN: lock the LCM touchscreens on both switches - they can factory-reset from the front panel and sit in public-facing rooms
OPEN: AP Groups 'bar' and 'dispensary' - then scope BAR-SECURE-WIFI / DISP-SECURE-WIFI to them. This also buys back SSID headroom against the 4-per-band cap
OPEN: DHCP guard with trusted server addresses on every network that has a DHCP server
OPEN: 5G Backup failover scoping - secure networks allowed, OPEN-NET and STAFF excluded, alert under 10 GB
OPEN: RF tuning pass: 5 GHz at 40 MHz, min RSSI -72, low data rates disabled, TX power medium
OPEN: the two-laptop ping tests, both directions - the whole build in one check, needs someone on site
OPEN: back up the site once the ping tests pass
